high_level_description: The image is a news graphic from CNBC, featuring a scenic view of London, England. The focal point of the image is the iconic Big Ben clock tower and the Houses of Parliament, with Westminster Bridge spanning across the River Thames in the foreground. The sky is clear with a few wispy clouds, suggesting a calm and pleasant day. The text overlay on the image reads: "England’s lifting of Covid lockdowns is a danger to the entire world, experts warn." This text is presented in a bold, white font against a dark blue background, which contrasts sharply with the lighter colors of the image below it.
